# oxr.recognition.v1

*Engine · recognition · package `linecaster-services`*

linecaster engine for the recognition step: a whole page through OXR's all-in-one service (D-FINE layout,
the OXR VLM per region and its reading order, the vendor's assembly), behind its HTTP API. The service runs in
the vendor's image (`ServiceServer` starts it); the engine is its client, in the pipeline's process.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Class | `linecaster_services:OxrRecognitionEngine` |
| Source | [oxr.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/engines/services/src/linecaster_services/oxr.py) |
| Reads | pages |
| Produces | lines, text, markdown |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `str` | `'http://127.0.0.1:8000'` | the API's base URL (the vendor image's port 8000, on loopback) |
| `output_formats` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `('markdown', 'json')` | the formats asked for; the page's text is the markdown |
| `timeout` | `float` | `1800.0` | seconds a page's request may take |
